messages:
maya: Heads up — customer 5421 opened a ticket: repeated 400s on function invoke for price_lookup, then intermittent 401s, and a billing spike from retries. Repro steps attached. Escalating for triage @arsen @leila.

arsen: Can you paste the exact request and any validation logs? Also need correlation id from their request headers.

maya: Repro curl from customer (redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{\n    "tool": "price_lookup",\n    "args": {\n      "sku": "XYZ-123",\n    }\n  }'
```
They get HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request and body: `{ \"error\": \"schema_validation_failed\", \"message\": \"unexpected trailing comma in args\" }`.

maya: From our runtime logs around 2026-03-14T18:22:10Z:
```
validation_error: payload[args] -> unexpected token "," at offset 42
request_id=req_0b9f3c
```

leila: Thanks — that trailing comma is a straightforward validation reject. But two things: 1) why did the model/tool selector pick price_lookup when the prompt sent a free-text intent? 2) why did their token rotate to a bad key and produce 401s later? We have failing golden tests in the toolcall-schema-suite this morning that look related to selector changes.

sam: FYI we deployed selector-v2 last night as part of the model routing experiment; can cause different tool choices for borderline prompts. Canary logs show 8% of requests picked a different tool than selector-v1. Suggest pinning selector back for this customer until we verify.

arsen: Routing logs (snippet):
```
route_decision: selector=selector-v2 model=price_lookup_ver1 confidence=0.58
headers: x-api-client-version=2.6.0 x-correlation-id=req_0b9f3c
auth_status: 200 -> 401 (token validation failed: kid mismatch)
```
Looks like a key rotation in our auth service caused transient 401s; that explains the auth complaints. The selector change explains tool choice variance and mismatched args causing validation errors.

leila: The CI golden failures all started after selector-v2 was promoted. Tests show different toolchoice for the same golden prompts leading to schema mismatches in our golden assertions. I'm opening a quick rollback PR for the selector model. Also adding a unit test to the toolcall-schema-suite to assert stable toolchoice for the golden set.

sam: Quick mitigation: pin routing for customer 5421 -> selector=selector-v1. Command (internal ops CLI):
```
redwood routes set --customer 5421 --selector selector-v1 --reason "urgent: repro + billing impact"
```
Can someone with ops perms run and confirm?

tess: I'm on it, running now.

ci-bot: Automated note: rerun requested for pipeline toolcall-schema-suite (run_id=ci_7842). Queued.

arsen: For the auth issue, we've pushed a hotfix to refresh the JWKS cache on key-rotate events and added extra logging for kid mismatches. Patch deployed to prod-auth at 18:45Z.

maya: Customer update prepared: explain root cause (selector experiment + trailing-comma payload -> validation reject) and auth key rotation. Offered to credit retry charges pending ops confirmation. @tess can you confirm billing credit workflow?

tess: Yep, I'll create a billing incident and loop finance. Tentative credit for retry tokens until the selector is pinned.

leila: Follow-ups: 1) rollback selector-v2 rollout and add canary thresholds, 2) add schema-linting on client-side SDK to catch trailing commas, 3) add golden-suite assertion on toolchoice. I'll file the tickets.

sam: Repro plan done: pin customer, rerun golden CI, monitor for 24h, then evaluate selector changes behind a stricter canary.

maya: Thanks all — assigning owners: @sam pinning/routing, @arsen auth hotfix & logging, @leila golden tests + rollback PR, @tess billing credit. Back to thread with CI results. :thumbsup:
